nodes.summary: There is a group $G$ in which every $4$-element subset contains two distinct elements generating a nilpotent subgroup, but some subgroup of $G$ generated by two elements is not nilpotent.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 17.3 has a negative answer

nodes.summary: The proposition that for every group $G$ in which every $4$-element subset contains two distinct elements generating a nilpotent subgroup, every subgroup of $G$ generated by two elements is nilpotent.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 17.3 (Abdollahi's question on nilpotent pairs)
